Requirements: R-9
Plan row: TS-11

## Given
Guest session G1 and a second guest session G2 with another cookie; the USER and ADMIN accounts; each with an empty cart.

## Steps
1. G1 adds book A; the USER (signed in) reads GET /api/cart.
2. The USER adds book B; G2 reads GET /api/cart.
3. Repeat 1 and 2 with ADMIN in place of USER.
4. G1 sends PUT and DELETE for the item id of the USER's line; then the USER reads the cart.

## Then
1. P-guest-vs-user: the USER cart shows what Q4 gives for an item added by a guest.
2. P-user-vs-guest: G2's cart shows what Q4 gives for an item added by the USER.
3. P-admin: the ADMIN carts show what Q4 gives for the same two checks.
4. P-foreign-item: the foreign PUT and DELETE get the answer Q4 gives, and the USER's own GET /api/cart afterwards (an allowed call by the same account) still holds the line unchanged.

## Obligation coverage
